source: Eurostat NACE Rev. 2 (Statistical Classification of Economic Activities in the European Community, Revision 2)
note: Hand-transcribed section-level (1-letter) codes from the official, fixed EU standard -- unchanged since the 2008 Rev. 2 publication, so no live-API refresh mechanism applies, same as isced_f_2013.json. Section level (21 entries) is deliberately used rather than the ~88 division-level (2-digit) codes: CAREER-INDUSTRIES is a low-weight candidate preference, not a precise classification requirement, and this coarser level can be transcribed from the standard with full confidence -- division-level codes would risk small labeling errors for a list this large recalled from memory rather than sourced from a machine-readable file.
